biography.bio:
A loud, trigger-happy pilot who mistakes volume of fire for a plan.

Masks: Buckshot, New Buckshot (wearing Buckshot).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.dUNZAvdWnRGgxhNn]{Vampire}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.9elarb46rSMnkGIk]{Vandal}, @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.6VCDAgl1sHilwgqF]{Vandal Recon Plane}.

V.E.N.O.M. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Blasts a spread of steel bearing balls.

Floyd Malloy's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. A hit of two degrees or more knocks the target Prone. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
The upgraded Buckshot: its bearing balls, plus a holographic double.

Floyd Malloy's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls against the targets and posts Apply Damage buttons (x degrees of success) and any Condition on a hit. Holo-Double: +2 Evasion until the end of the wearer's next turn. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You never fight fair. Once per scene, as a free action, line up a cheap shot: your next attack this turn is upshifted once.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Use button: once per scene, marks you until the end of your turn. Your next attack is upshifted once and uses the mark up.

system.description:
You drive with one hand and aim with the other. A vehicle you are driving has Edge on its Targeting Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive has Edge on its Targeting Tests (its weapons).
